title: Is the new Water Cyber Shield Act too little, too late, and can a cyber group do it better? The experts weigh in
summary: Two US senators have proposed a new Water Cyber Shield Act to provide the EPA with additional funding and tools to conduct cybersecurity assessments on critical water infrastructure. So, my fingers are crossed, but I'm not holding my breath.
